name: Shanxi Meijin Energy Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanxi Meijin Energy Co.,Ltd. produces and sells coking coal and coking by-products in China. The company is involved in the production and sales of coal, coking, natural gas, chemical products, new energy vehicles, including hydrogen fuel cell vehicles; ethylene glycol, and carbon black; chemical products; pig iron, coke, coke powder, dedusting ash, coke oven gas, coal tar, crude benzene/light benzene, ammonium sulfate, sulfur, provides power media, including compressed air, steam, nitrogen, electricity, and desalted; urea and LNG products; metal materials and steel products.
